connections.notes: Fresh feed: (2, 1, 0) mol/s at 300 K and P_r, liquid (C absent).
Reactor outlet at 315 K, lifted; LIQUID at the solution.

description: SYN-001-UL-C2 with component_set.components = [C, A, B]; every component-keyed value is keyed by id and unchanged. Corpus STA-04 (T06 spec §3.2, §4.2, Amendment 1): the binding maps the declared order onto the provider's (A, B, C), so declaration, label, trace and certificate are C2's; never solved with the components swapped; verified_at_reference at NET-08's root under T06-revision-v1 and T05b-v2.

policy.fidelity: boundary condition; the fresh feed state is fully specified
adiabatic component and energy balance (K02, unchanged)
policy.validity: every port liquid (R-038); the closure is restricted to the subcooled-liquid domain

conversion.A.meaning: Conversion X of the key reactant A (the key is the name's suffix, design note §1.3)

nu.A.meaning: Stoichiometric coefficient of A in the one reaction 2A + B -> 3C (T05 spec §6.4)

nu.B.meaning: Stoichiometric coefficient of B in the one reaction 2A + B -> 3C (T05 spec §6.4)

nu.C.meaning: Stoichiometric coefficient of C in the one reaction 2A + B -> 3C (T05 spec §6.4)

pressure_drop.meaning: Declared pressure drop across the reactor; zero here, imposed as an equation P_out = P_in rather than assumed (ADR 0001 D4.5)

policy.fidelity: one reaction at a specified conversion of the key reactant and a specified outlet temperature; duty calculated (T05 spec §6, ADR 0011 D2)

split.A.meaning: Fraction of A sent to the top outlet (T05 spec §7)

split.B.meaning: Fraction of B sent to the top outlet (T05 spec §7)

split.C.meaning: Fraction of C sent to the top outlet (T05 spec §7)

policy.fidelity: per-component split to declared-phase outlets; duty calculated (T05 spec §7)
policy.validity: top and bottom declared liquid; inlet lifted

policy.fidelity: boundary; accepts a stream and imposes no equation on it
policy.validity: accepts any phase signature including ZERO_FLOW

provenance.actor: Opus 5.5 (T06 M1, build lane, from the design-lane specification)
provenance.notes: Diagnosis fixture: the parent revision with exactly the one change the specification states. Never expected to solve.

specifications.notes: Reactor outlet temperature (the reactor's energy specification); the duty is calculated.
